--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_unset_filesystem_neutral.py
@@ -0,0 +1,76 @@
+import os
+import stat
+import sys
+
+import pytest
+
+import dotenv
+
+
+def _identity(path):
+    info = path.stat()
+    return (
+        info.st_dev,
+        info.st_ino,
+        stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode),
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("policy", [None, False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "contents",
+    [b"", b"a=x\nc=d", b"\xef\xbb\xbfexport a='x'\r\nc=d\r\n"],
+)
+def test_missing_unset_regular_is_neutral(tmp_path, caplog, policy, contents):
+    path = tmp_path / ".env"
+    path.write_bytes(contents)
+    if sys.platform != "win32":
+        path.chmod(0o640)
+    before = _identity(path)
+    kwargs = {} if policy is None else {"follow_symlinks": policy}
+
+    with caplog.at_level("WARNING", logger="dotenv.main"):
+        result = dotenv.unset_key(path, "missing", **kwargs)
+
+    assert result == (None, "missing")
+    assert path.read_bytes() == contents
+    if sys.platform != "win32":
+        assert _identity(path) == before
+    assert caplog.messages == [
+        f"Key missing not removed from {path} - key doesn't exist."
+    ]
+    assert set(tmp_path.iterdir()) == {path}
+
+
+@pytest.mark.skipif(sys.platform == "win32", reason="Unix symlink semantics")
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("policy", [None, False, True])
+def test_missing_unset_symlink_is_neutral(tmp_path, caplog, policy):
+    target = tmp_path / "target.env"
+    contents = b"\xef\xbb\xbfexport a='x'\r\nc=d\r\n"
+    target.write_bytes(contents)
+    target.chmod(0o640)
+    link = tmp_path / ".env"
+    link.symlink_to(target.name)
+    link_before = link.lstat()
+    target_before = _identity(target)
+    kwargs = {} if policy is None else {"follow_symlinks": policy}
+
+    with caplog.at_level("WARNING", logger="dotenv.main"):
+        result = dotenv.unset_key(link, "missing", **kwargs)
+
+    assert result == (None, "missing")
+    assert link.is_symlink()
+    assert os.readlink(link) == target.name
+    link_after = link.lstat()
+    assert (link_after.st_dev, link_after.st_ino, link_after.st_mode) == (
+        link_before.st_dev,
+        link_before.st_ino,
+        link_before.st_mode,
+    )
+    assert _identity(target) == target_before
+    assert target.read_bytes() == contents
+    assert link.read_bytes() == contents
+    assert caplog.messages == [
+        f"Key missing not removed from {link} - key doesn't exist."
+    ]
+    assert set(tmp_path.iterdir()) == {link, target}

spec.question:
Make `dotenv.unset_key` filesystem-neutral when the requested key is absent from an existing dotenv file. It must still return `(None, key_to_unset)` and emit the existing missing-key warning, but leave the file's bytes unchanged and, on Unix, preserve its inode and mode. If the supplied path is a symlink to an existing file, leave both the link and its target intact, including their identities and contents, whether `follow_symlinks` is omitted, false, or true. No temporary files should remain after the call.

Successful deletions must keep their established behavior: a regular file loses the matching bindings; a symlink is replaced without modifying its target by default, while `follow_symlinks=True` edits the target and preserves the link. Keep the existing encoding support, parser warnings, and behavior for nonexistent paths. The successful-operation expectations in `test_unset_with_value`, `test_unset_key_symlink_to_existing_file`, and `test_unset_key_follow_symlinks` must continue to hold. Return a unified diff against production files only; do not change tests.
